leadText: Roadblocking of Old Snorlax (Japanese: カビゴンおやじのとおせんぼ KABIGON Geezer used BLOCK) is the fifth episode of A Pocketful of Adventures. It first aired in Japan on November 17, 2023, and in the Middle East and North Africa on May 18, 2024.
